Coram : P. SATHASIVAM*, RANJAN GOGOI
Code of Civil Procedure, 1908: A B Or II, r. 2 - Two suits on same cause of action - Bar u/Or II, c r. 2 - Object - Applicability - Held: Or. II r. 2 seeks to avoid multiplicity of litigations on same cause of action - The Rule engrafts a laudable principle that discourages/prohibits vexing again by multiple suits except in a situation where one of the several reliefs, though available to 0 a plaintiff, may not have been claimed for a good reason - A later suit for such relief is contemplated only with the leave of the Court, granted upon due satisfaction and for good and
Decision Date : 07-09-2012 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 6372/2012 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
